description: RFC 0002 owned-file inventory. Each record resolves a file to its current owner and its target module, with responsibility/effect/state classification, provenance, and symbol-level splits for mixed files.

coverage.note: Seeded from the RFC 0002 observed-evidence table, the first geometry extraction candidate, and the extracted strict geometry module (public/hammer/geometry, hammer/core/geometry). filesClassified counts authored records, which now include new strict-module files in addition to legacy hammer/ files. Exhaustive per-file/per-symbol classification is the H0 exit condition and is tracked as HAM-INVENTORY-001; validator enforces full coverage only when status is 'complete'.

files.note: Common precompiled header pulls afxwin.h/afxext.h and Windows facilities. Removing a visible include does not establish portability; strict modules must not include this PCH.
CHammer combines MFC lifecycle and engine application-system composition. Bootstrap, service ownership, and UI lifetime need separate owners.

symbolSplits.note: MFC lifecycle retained on the legacy side of the seam.

files.note: CMapDoc derives from CDocument; editing state and operations cannot currently be instantiated independently of the MFC document layer.

symbolSplits.note: Mutations routed through the transaction boundary (HAM005).

files.note: Scene base exposes selection, rendering, transforms, persistence, and notifications. CMapAtom::SetParent accepts any parent; characterize the implicit base contract before extraction.

symbolSplits.note: Observed runtime-type narrowing vs CMapClass::SetParent; target API validates parent/child before mutation.

files.note: Broad base contract hides which behaviors each object actually supports; separate persistent content from render caches, UI state, and file encoding.
CSelection::SelectObject commits and invalidates property-dialog state; extracting selection must preserve the property-commit policy while removing the window dependency (HAM-SEL-001).

symbolSplits.note: Property-draft commit policy moves to the application layer; SaveData() coupling to the property sheet is removed.

files.note: CBaseTool has repeated 2D/3D/logical input entry points coupled to concrete view classes; normalize input and share gesture mechanics.
CMapView::GetViewWnd returns CWnd*; the current interface cannot serve an ordinary GTK or headless host. Split projection/picking/extraction from native window ownership.

IEditorTexture draws through CDC/RECT/CPalette; split asset metadata, decoded-image access, thumbnail generation, and private render bindings. Characterize GetImageWidth vs GetWidth before deduplication.

symbolSplits.note: Image vs mapping dimensions may differ; characterize before merge (do not treat the removal comment as evidence).

files.note: CVGuiWnd::DrawVGuiPanel passes native window handles into material-system views; native details must be confined to the private interop bridge.
CRender3D::BeginRenderHitTarget/EndRenderHitTarget convert object pointers to unsigned int and back; a 64-bit migration must replace pointer encoding with bounded pick identifiers (HAM009).

symbolSplits.note: GPU pick IDs index a frame-scoped table; they must not contain truncated object pointers.

files.note: Axis-aligned bounding box value type; depends only on mathlib/vector.h. First bounded geometry extraction candidate (HAM-GEOMETRY-001). Note the lone virtual IsIntersectingBox: characterize callers before deciding the extracted shape.
Implements BoundBox update/intersection/snap; extract with explicit grid/tolerance policy and preserve existing precision (HAM-GEOMETRY-001).

New strict public header: hammer::geometry::AxisAlignedBox + Vec3, extracted from BoundBox. Dependency-free (only <cstddef>); no MFC/tier0/PCH. Owns its geometric value type per the hammer.geometry contract (HAM-GEOMETRY-001).

New strict implementation of AxisAlignedBox. Compiles headlessly under gcc and clang (-std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror); verified by unittests/hammertest/geometry/test_aabb.cpp via unittests/hammertest/run_headless.sh. SnapToGrid routes through hammer::geometry::RoundHalfAwayFromZero (rounding.h) for legacy V_rint fidelity.

Named owner of the grid-rounding policy (round half away from zero), extracted from hammer_mathlib V_rint. Consumed by AxisAlignedBox::SnapToGrid; the single authoritative definition of the snap rounding rule (DRY).
Verbatim port of hammer_mathlib.cpp V_rint (floor(f+0.5)/ceil(f-0.5)). Verified by unittests/hammertest/geometry/test_rounding.cpp, which pins the .5 boundaries where this differs from std::rint.

Angle numeric policies (NormalizeAngleDegrees, LineAngleDegrees) extracted from hammer_mathlib fixang/lineangle. Preserves the legacy single-step wrap quirk and RAD2DEG expansion exactly; future rotation/2D tools will share this owner.
Verbatim port of fixang/lineangle. Verified by test_angle.cpp (incl. the 720->360 legacy quirk) plus a full-modulo sensitivity provider that the oracle catches.

Strong runtime NodeHandle value type (document + slot index + generation). Distinct from persistent VMF ids, history identity, and GPU pick ids per the RFC state-ownership rules. Dependency-free (only <cstdint>).
Generational slot table issuing/validating NodeHandles for one document. Implements the RFC stale-reference check and independent-document isolation.
HandleTable implementation. Compiles headlessly under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by unittests/hammertest/scene/test_handle_table.cpp plus a stale-accepting negative provider.
Scene node graph and its mutation/query boundary (RFC 0002 H1). Handle-addressed; validated reparent (cycle/self/foreign-document) and atomic subtree delete. Consumes hammer.scene handles.

SceneGraph implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_scene_graph.cpp (no-cycle, atomic reparent/delete, stale rejection, two documents) plus a permissive negative provider.

Independent document history reference model (revision counter vs saved position, no-op neutrality, undo/redo). The RFC verification-strategy oracle for transaction/history semantics ahead of full H3 authority.

DocumentHistory implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_document_history.cpp (incl. undo-to-saved clears modified though revision advanced) plus a revision-based negative provider.
Multi-selection property aggregation (Unset/Single/Mixed) owning the RFC empty-vs-unset-vs-mixed distinction. Foundational value type for the HAM-SEL-001 selection/property worked migration.
PropertyValue implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_property_value.cpp plus an empty-as-unset negative provider that the oracle catches.
VMF/keyvalues document model, parser, writer, and versioned semantic comparator API. Foundation for the H2 persistence slice and the HAM-CORPUS-001 comparator; preserves unknown chunks.

VMF/keyvalues parser/writer/comparator. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_keyvalues.cpp (parse, round-trip + unknown preservation, malformed diagnostics, comparator normalization) plus a permissive-comparator negative provider that the data-loss oracle catches.
